title: the Glass Steppe Rising
author: Hazel Montrose
blurb: Beatrix Montrose, a cartographer of unmapped realms, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
